text: We are staring at a leaderboard so cramped it looks like a goal-mouth scramble in double overtime, with Olivier and The Camaraderie clinging to a razor-thin one-point lead over the rest of the pack. While the top tier is playing a game of chicken, Louis Do and Philippe Guite are the ones making noise, surging up the standings and effectively shoving Renaud and The rookie into a downward spiral that has him looking for answers. It is absolute bedlam in the middle of the pack where nearly everyone is deadlocked at seventeen points, turning every single roster move into a high-stakes chess match. If the bottom-dwellers do not start shaking up their lineups soon, I predict we will see Guigui and Layne Hudson mathematically eliminated before the leaves even finish falling off the trees.
